note: Importance-weighted conformal on the |y−ŷ| residual is a no-op — not because cal and test residual magnitudes match (they need not), but because corr(|residual|, test-likeness) ≈ 0 WITHIN the calibration set: reweighting only reallocates probability mass across calibration residuals by test-era-likeness, and when that reallocation is uninformed by residual size it cannot systematically favor larger or smaller residuals, so the reweighted quantile lands unchanged.
